authorization: 多轮实验的prompt authorizes Step 2 pilot only. This is a MINIMAL pilot chosen by the research lead ('先做最小可行 pilot'). No Step 3, no ProcessGuard, no full confirmatory study.
external_validity: NOT claimed. telecom + 18-task set deferred to full pilot pending approval.
primary_estimand: A - N1 per stratum, paired within (task,model,snapshot,replicate)
task_selection: blind, by gold-action structure only; NO R7-C PASR / condition ranking / high-signal task used (verified: task ids chosen from structural filters in build_task_registry.py).
environment: official tau2 retail/airline environments; real tool arg parsing, real DB mutation, official evaluate_simulation; E0 gate PASS.
review: dual-independent-LLM (two fresh, isolated review agents; different model families where possible; disagreements fail-closed and are marked UNRESOLVED_DISAGREEMENT; NOT human-validated). If reviewers cannot close -> REVIEW_NOT_CLOSED.
decision: The minimal pilot yields NO S2 branch decision. It yields: (a) pipeline validity, (b) A−N1 direction + CI, (c) a recommendation on whether to run the full 18-task pilot.
stop_rule: Freeze -> gates -> run 120 -> analyze -> dual post-run review -> report -> STOP for research-lead approval.
